questions.text: Which one of the following functions is continuous at x = 3?
questions.solution:
Option 1 at x = 3: f(3) = 2, right limit 3 [latex]-[/latex] 1 = 2, left limit (3 + 3)/3 = 2 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] continuous.

- Option 2: limit 5 [latex]\ne[/latex] f(3) = 4
- Option 3: left 6, right [latex]-[/latex]1
- Option 4: not defined at 3

Answer: Option 1

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: [latex]f(x)=\left\{\begin{matrix} 2, & if \; x=3\\ x-1,& if \;  x \gt 3\\ \frac{x+3}{3},&if \; x \lt 3 \end{matrix}\right.[/latex]

questions.text:
Which one of the following does NOT equal
[latex]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & x&x^{2} \\ 1& y & y^{2}\\ 1&z & z^{2} \end{bmatrix}[/latex]?
questions.solution:
Adding one row/column to another does not change a determinant:
- Option 2: add column 1 to columns 2 and 3 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] same
- Option 3: [latex]R_1-R_2[/latex], [latex]R_2-R_3[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] same
- Option 4: [latex]R_1+R_2[/latex], [latex]R_2+R_3[/latex], then undo with row operations [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] same
- Option 1: columns 1, [latex]x^2+x[/latex], [latex]x+1[/latex] reduce to columns 1, [latex]x^2[/latex], x, i.e. columns 2 and 3 swapped [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] the sign changes

Answer: Option 1

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: [latex]\begin{bmatrix} 0& x-y & x^{2}-y^2 \\ 0& y-z & y^{2}- z^2 \\ 1&z & z^{2} \end{bmatrix}[/latex]

questions.text: The bisection method is applied to compute a zero of the function  [latex]f(x) = x^{4}-x^{3}-x^{2}-4[/latex] in the interval [1,9]. The method converges to a solution after _____iterations.
questions.solution:
f(1) = [latex]-[/latex]5 [latex]\lt[/latex] 0 and f(9) [latex]\gt[/latex] 0.

- Iteration 1: x = 5, f(5) = 471 [latex]\gt[/latex] 0 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [1, 5]
- Iteration 2: x = 3, f(3) = 41 [latex]\gt[/latex] 0 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [1, 3]
- Iteration 3: x = 2, f(2) = 16 [latex]-[/latex] 8 [latex]-[/latex] 4 [latex]-[/latex] 4 = 0 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] root found

Answer: 3
